holder-quote: A small army’s worth, [Hunt Commander] Makhir, Dragonspeaker.
[Hunt Commander] Makhir nearly ran down General Milka.
Spearmaster Lulv growled an agreement to [Hunt Commander] Makhir.
Only Makhir would have heard, and the [Hunt Commander] affected not to.

Ferris hesitated as Makhir scanned the street they were walking down. The [Hunt Commander] had a double bodyguard of [Soldiers] from Manus, all with bows, casually strolling along. Rafaema saw him glance at Makhir and the Gnoll coughed.
Makhir seems to guard you, Rafaema
the only Gnoll member of the Council voicing a comment he thought might be against his mentor. But the [Hunt Commander] just shook his head.
